_comment: Configuration for the agentic loop. Select the engine and edit model IDs / intervals here. Env overrides: AGENTIC_ENGINE, AGENTIC_PLANNER_MODEL, AGENTIC_EXECUTOR_MODEL.

promptOverlays._comment: Project deltas appended to ANTfrastructure's shared role prompts. Engine-agnostic on purpose: the loop composes shared+overlay once and delivers it to claude via --append-system-prompt-file AND to opencode as .opencode/agents/<role>.md. This block is the source of truth; the identical keys under engines.claude are a COMPATIBILITY MIRROR, not a second setting - see the note there. Assert-AgenticPromptOverlay fails the loop if the two disagree, so edit both or neither.

claude._comment: Claude Code CLI (claude -p). Planner: Opus 5 with Fable 5 fallback when unavailable/overloaded (via claude --fallback-model). Executor: Sonnet. Planner is sandboxed to read-only tools + BACKLOG.md edits; executor runs with bypassPermissions (trusted repo).
claude._commentPromptOverlayMirror: plannerPromptOverlayFile / executorPromptOverlayFile are mirrored from the top-level promptOverlays block because ANTfrastructure's reader at the pinned commit (WindowsAgenticLoop.Common.psm1, Resolve-AgenticEngine) looks them up under engines.<engine> and nowhere else. Moving them out to the top level alone made both overlays unread - and unread SILENTLY, because a missing overlay is not an error there. Keep the mirror until the pinned hub reads promptOverlays; AgenticPromptOverlay.psm1 (Windows) and the assert_prompt_overlays preflight in Run-AgenticLoop.sh (Linux) check that the overlay actually reaches the agent and fail the loop when it does not.
claude.plannerAllowedTools: Read Glob Grep Edit(BACKLOG.md) Bash(git:*) PowerShell(git:*)

models._comment: Legacy fallback used when the engines block has no entry for the selected engine.

buildMatrix._comment: Build configurations cycled through by the agentic loop. Each entry has: name, sanitizer (asan|tsan|none), buildDir, buildType, testCommand (or null). Windows builds via Stevedore container; Linux builds via Rancher Desktop.

backlog._comment: skipPlannerWhenTasksPending: go straight to the executor while BACKLOG.md still has unchecked tasks. deleteCompletedTasks: prune completed (- [x]) entries from BACKLOG.md after each task — history lives in git.
